description: Physical interactions between Pfam protein-domain families, evidenced by domain–domain interfaces observed in Protein Data Bank crystal structures. Interactions between members of the same domain family are represented as self-loops.

common_properties.name: last_updated
common_properties.description: Time the relationship was last created or updated.

source_contributions.scope: Interfaces between different asymmetric-unit chains that appear in at least one PISA-validated biological assembly (NumPisaBAs > 0), with different protein identifiers on the two sides. No symmetry-operator restriction applies. Both domain families must exist as ProteinDomain nodes in SPOKE; the specific proteins need not exist in SPOKE.
source_contributions.description: ProtCID (Protein Common Interface Database; Dunbrack lab) summarizes interfaces in PDB crystal structures by Pfam domain family. Each relationship records the existence of an interaction for an unordered domain-family pair; interface statistics and individual structure identifiers are not included. Same-family interactions reflect distinct proteins carrying the same Pfam family.
